entities.name: Query octanoyltransferase
observations: The 223-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry B2VBK0 from Erwinia tasmaniensis.
Contains the Pfam LplA-B_cat catalytic domain (PF21948.2) at positions 26–200.
Belongs to the BPL/LPL catalytic family; curated homologs identify it as octanoyltransferase EC 2.3.1.181.
Curated active-site annotation places an acyl-thioester intermediate at the catalytic cysteine region; a nearby site lowers the pKa of that cysteine.

entities.name: Octanoyl-ACP protein transfer
observations: Reaction: octanoyl-[acyl-carrier protein] + lysyl-[protein] → N6-octanoyl-L-lysyl-[protein] + holo-[acyl-carrier protein] + H+.
The enzyme transfers an octanoyl group to the lipoyl-lysine acceptor site of lipoate-dependent enzyme lipoyl domains.
Assigned EC number is 2.3.1.181; mapped to Rhea RHEA:17665.

entities.name: Endogenous protein lipoylation
observations: This enzyme catalyzes step 1 of endogenous protein lipoylation: octanoyl transfer onto lipoate-dependent enzyme lipoyl domains before subsequent sulfur insertion to form lipoyl-lysine.
The protein is annotated as cytoplasmic in reviewed homologs.
